description: Adapt the crop overlay for Windows. Use transparent BrowserWindow with WS_EX_LAYERED and WS_EX_TRANSPARENT for click-through regions. Handle DPI scaling correctly for crop coordinates, multi-monitor spanning, and Windows compositor (DWM) interaction. The overlay must render at native resolution without blur even on high-DPI displays. Test on both single and multi-monitor setups with mixed scaling.
title: Windows crop overlay (transparent click-through window)
